description.text: One of two 60-card Arceus LV.X Constructed Standard Decks released on 8 July 2009 with the Advent of Arceus expansion, when the mythical Pokémon Arceus first appeared on cards. Each deck holds seven Arceus cards in all, Arceus LV.X and Arceus of types and attacks the expansion doesn't have, here Lightning and Psychic, and seven holo cards, printed in a holo pattern only Arceus uses. Every Arceus carries the Arceus Rule, which lets a deck hold as many copies as its player likes; with the other deck and the expansion, every type of Arceus can be collected. Damage counters and markers, a coin and a how-to-play book came with it.
